Prompt: List all the metrics.
Comments: [Kept] Prometheus: truth = every metric name in Prometheus (/api/v1/label/__name__/values; hundreds: DCGM, vLLM, node). Pass = stated total matches and every name shown exists. DCGM: truth = the DCGM_FI_* names the connector supports (25 on the supported list) that are present in Prometheus. Pass = every one named, none invented.

Prompt: List all the GPU metrics.
Comments: [Kept] Also run on a fresh connector: discovery must work with no pre-seeded schema. Truth = every DCGM_FI_* name present in Prometheus. Pass = every one named, none invented. Watch: the two exporters expose different sets (PROF_* only on hgx-su00-v100, no XID on hgx-su00-v100) - the list is the union of both.

Prompt: Plot GPU utilization for past 1 hour.
Comments: [Kept] Truth = DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL over the last 1h (query_range, step 60s). Pass = a chart is returned (one line per GPU or per host) and any number written in the text is within +/-10 points of the source avg/max for that GPU or host.

Prompt: Plot GPU utilization for past 24 hours.
Comments: [Kept] Same check as the 1h prompt over 24h. Watch: last time NCP plotted max by (ip) (one line per host) and its text contradicted its own data ('all other GPUs at 0%' while 10.4.5.33 averaged 83%) - the text numbers are checked against Prometheus, not only the chart. Empty chart widget is a known UI bug (not visible to this check).

Prompt: Show power and temperature utilization for past 24 hours.
Comments: [Kept] Truth = DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE (W) and DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP (C) over 24h, avg and max per GPU or host. Pass = temp within +/-3 C, power within +/-10%. A chart alone is fine; numbers in text must match.

Prompt: Show current GPU temperature and power draw.
Comments: [Kept] Truth = DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP and DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE at the time of the answer. Pass = all 14 GPUs covered, temp +/-3 C, power +/-10%. Watch: hgx-su00-a6000 runs NCP's own LLM - its GPUs heat up while NCP answers, so read the truth at the tool time (agent_trace), not later.

Prompt: Show GPU memory utilization for each GPU.
Comments: [Kept] Truth = memory used % = FB_USED / (FB_USED + FB_FREE + FB_RESERVED if present) x 100. Pass = all 14 GPUs, each within +/-3 points. Watch: DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_COPY_UTIL is memory bandwidth busy %, not memory used - accept it only if the answer says that is what it shows.

Prompt: Show current GPU throttling status.
Comments: [Kept - negative test] No throttling metric is exported in this lab (DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS / CLOCKS_EVENT_REASONS absent). Pass = NCP says throttling data is not available. Fail = it states a throttling status as fact (e.g. guessed from temperature or clocks). Re-check the metric is still absent before each run; if it appears, compare per GPU instead.

Prompt: Show GPU ECC error counters.
Comments: [Kept - likely negative test] Truth = DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_SBE_* / DBE_* - NOT CONFIRMED whether exported (dcgm-exporter leaves ECC off by default; the supported list has remapped rows + XID instead). If absent: pass = NCP says ECC counters are not available (it may show remapped rows / XID if it labels them as such). If present: every GPU's counters must match.

Prompt: Which GPUs are the hottest right now?
Comments: [Kept] Truth = DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP at answer time. Pass = the first GPU named is the hottest (ties within +/-3 C ok), named by host + GPU index. Watch the two-names trap: NCP shows the DCGM Hostname label (hgx-su00-a6000-2) while Prometheus instance can differ (ncp02) - match on Hostname.

Prompt: Rank GPUs by utilization.
Comments: [Kept] Truth = DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL at answer time. Pass = all 14 GPUs ranked; order matches except between GPUs within +/-10 points of each other. Watch: most GPUs sit at 0% (ties are normal); hgx-su00-a6000 utilization moves with NCP's own chat traffic.

Prompt: Which GPUs are idle or underutilized?
Comments: [Kept] The prompt gives no threshold, so: pass = every GPU at or below 5% utilization is listed and no GPU above 30% is listed (5-30% may go either way). Truth = DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL at answer time.

Prompt: Show currently firing alerts grouped by severity.
Comments: [Kept] Prometheus: truth = /api/v1/alerts (state=firing) grouped by the severity label. Pass = every firing alert under the right severity, or 'no alerts firing' when there are none (NOT CONFIRMED that alert rules exist on 10.20.0.41:9091). DCGM: the connector has no alerts - pass = NCP says alerts are not available from DCGM; any listed alert = FAIL (invented).

Prompt: Give me an overall GPU fleet health summary.
Comments: [Kept] Pass = covers 14 GPUs on 6 hosts (GPU_TEMP is the denominator) and flags every GPU with XID > 0, a row-remap failure / uncorrectable remapped rows, or temperature > 85 C (policy warning band). GPUs with no series = 'no data', never 0 or healthy. Watch: hgx-su00-v100 (4 GPUs) has no XID series. Optional judge note for wording only.

Prompt: Show average GPU utilization for the previous week.
Comments: [Kept] Truth = avg_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL[7d]) per GPU, plus the fleet mean. Pass = within +/-5 points. 'Previous week' = last 7 days; if NCP uses the previous calendar week it must say so and that window is compared instead. Prometheus keeps 7+ days (checked 2026-09-19).

Prompt: Pie chart of active alerts by severity.
Comments: [Kept] Prometheus: pass = a pie chart whose slices match firing-alert counts per severity (/api/v1/alerts); with no alerts NCP must say so, not draw an empty or made-up chart. DCGM: no alerts - pass = NCP says not available.

Prompt: How many GPUs are being monitored, and on which hosts?
Comments: [New] Truth = count(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP) by Hostname = 14 GPUs on 6 hosts (rtxpro6000 3, a6000 4, v100 4, a100 1, a5000 1, a6000-2 1 - re-read before each run). Pass = right total, every host with its count. Catches answers that count from a metric that covers only 10 GPUs (e.g. XID).

Prompt: Show XID errors for all GPUs over the last 7 days.
Comments: [New] Truth = max_over_time(DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS[7d]). Pass = every GPU with XID > 0 named with its code, 'none' when none; the 4 hgx-su00-v100 GPUs reported as 'no data', not 0. Keeps an earlier fix (V100 XID shown as 0) from coming back.

Prompt: Show framebuffer memory used and free for each GPU.
Comments: [New] Truth = DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED and DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE (MiB). Pass = all 14 GPUs; used and free each within +/-3% of that GPU's total memory. Catches MiB/GB conversion mistakes.

Prompt: Show tensor core and DRAM activity for each GPU.
Comments: [New] Truth = DCGM_FI_PROF_PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE and DCGM_FI_PROF_DRAM_ACTIVE (0-1 ratio = %). Only the 4 hgx-su00-v100 GPUs export these. Pass = those 4 within +/-5 points; the other 10 GPUs reported as 'no data', never 0.

Prompt: Show row remapping status for each GPU.
Comments: [New] Truth = DCGM_FI_DEV_CORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS, DCGM_FI_DEV_UNCORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS, DCGM_FI_DEV_ROW_REMAP_FAILURE. Pass = values match per GPU; any GPU with uncorrectable rows or a remap failure is flagged; GPUs without these series reported as 'no data'.

Prompt: Show current GPU utilization, temperature and power for host hgx-su00-a6000-2.
Comments: [New] Truth = series with Hostname="hgx-su00-a6000-2" (1 RTX A6000; its Prometheus instance is 'ncp02'). Pass = exactly one GPU; util +/-10, temp +/-3 C, power +/-10%. Tests the two-names trap. Change the host name if the fleet changes.
